game_title: Max Finder Derby – Druid Grove Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Druid Grove, the druids' grove: the forest ranger must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Druid Grove: the druids' grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Druid Grove, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round, a new dewdrops challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the best value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of dewdrops by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how best changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Druid Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
